description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity that demonstrates handling of committed content via InputConnectionCompat, including support for different MIME types and permission management, with UI components to display content details.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that facilitates testing and handling of input content commit operations, supporting MIME type filtering and permission management, with UI components to display content metadata.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, and restores previous input content info if available.

methods.name: onCommitContent
methods.description: Handles committed input content, verifies MIME types, requests permissions if needed, and updates UI.

methods.name: onCommitContentInternal
methods.description: Processes the input content info, updates display fields, manages permission, and loads content into WebView.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current input content state for configuration changes or activity recreation.

methods.name: createEditTextWithContentMimeTypes
methods.description: Creates a configured EditText that specifies content MIME types for testing by setting EditorInfo#contentMimeTypes.

methods.name: flagsToString
methods.description: Converts the flags parameter into a human-readable string for display.
